name: Asset Alchemist
title: Cinematic Life Command — Entertainment & Everyday Utility
subtitle: Cinematic Life Command — Entertainment & Everyday Utility
features: NEW Life Command Studio 32: private everyday organizer with tasks, important dates, priority, categories, notes and recurring daily, weekly or monthly routines
Life Command adds daily completion tracking, habit streaks, overdue and upcoming-date summaries, searchable task boards, and one-tap access from Companion Center and the iPhone navigation dock
Export or import Life Command JSON backups and share an ICS calendar for dated events, with local-only browser storage and no account or background notification claims
Enhanced Animation Forge with mobile, balanced, smooth and cinematic quality profiles, GIF frame/memory preflight, playhead trim shortcuts and exact duplicate-frame reduction
Improved Video Vault with saved scene bookmarks, renamable display titles, playback speed controls, session-only local VTT captions, frame PNG snapshots and metadata catalog export
Integrated direct Video Vault to Animation Forge handoff for saved local videos, automatically selecting a short GIF clip from the chosen playback timestamp
Expanded Media Theater with 10-second rewind, 30-second skip and precise A/B section loops for music or video
Refined iPhone-responsive interface while preserving 24 active Companion spaces, existing video files, projects, Reactor IV, Master Visual Identity and Token Foundry unchanged
Maintained secure automated GitHub-to-Discord release announcements with real changelog and no PC hosting required
